title: Origin story: Thunderbird
description: Thunderbird is the mighty sky-being of many Native traditions, whose wingbeats are thunder and whose eyes flash lightning. He hunts the great horned serpents of the deep waters, and his battles with them shake the earth. Totem poles carry his image as the sky's supreme power.

title: Ability profile: Thunderbird
description: Ranked abilities: Storm command — rank 100/100; Flight — rank 99/100; Strength — rank 98/100; Lightning — rank 97/100; Majesty — rank 96/100.

title: Power ranking: Thunderbird
description: Powers: Thunder as his wingbeat; Lightning as his glance; The sky itself as his hunting ground.

title: Stamina feats: Thunderbird
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Battles sea-serpents for ages; Circles the sky eternally.

title: Crossover notes: Thunderbird
description: Thunderbird crosses naturally with: thunder, storms, the sky's power.

title: Cultural impact: Thunderbird
description: The thunderbird is the Northwest Coast's great crest; storm as majesty.

title: Generator record: Thunderbird
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Thunderbird's database.
